QuestInfo.name: [Arcana] With Determination
QuestInfo.0: Write a letter to send to the Alliance about the information on the Arcane River obtained in Arcana. You can make the letter into a paper boat to float on the #bcalm water#k in the #bForest Entrance#k.
QuestInfo.1: The paper boat traveled far up the river of Arcana. ...Will this paper boat reach the Alliance? It would be great if it did...
